completion:
Okay, here's a comprehensive set of instructions for accurately documenting failed brake tests in a vehicle inspection report, building on your starting point of "Start with the inspection records."  This is broken down into sections for clarity, covering preparation, the testing process, and meticulous documentation.  It aims to be legally sound and help avoid misunderstandings.

**I. Preparation & Initial Inspection Records Review (Building on "Start with the inspection records")**

1. **Vehicle Identification:**  Verify the Vehicle Identification Number (VIN) on the vehicle *matches* the VIN on the inspection request/work order/repair documents. This is critical for preventing errors and potential legal issues. Record the VIN in the appropriate section of the inspection report. Also record Make, Model, and Year.
2. **Review Existing Records:** *Thoroughly* review any previous inspection reports, repair orders, or maintenance records related to the brakes.  Note any previous brake
